summary: A Yes vote authorizes the Visalia Unified School District to issue general obligation bonds, repaid by a property tax, to repair and upgrade school facilities.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes funding for local school facility improvements through a bond paid for by property owners.
tax.quote: If passed, Measure Z would provide $158 million for local school facility improvements at a cost of $40 per $100,000 of assessed value (not market value).

schools.text: A Yes vote authorizes funding for repairs, upgrades, and modern learning spaces in Visalia Unified district schools.
